tools.name: search_open_loads
tools.description: Open loads on the boards right now: route, escort type, pay, date and a link. No company names or contact details. Optionally filter by a state the load starts or ends in.

tools.name: search_open_jobs
tools.description: Open jobs from companies and fleets hiring pilot car / P/EVO subcontractors or drivers: title, company, contractor or employee, vehicle and gear, pay, schedule, base location and a link. Applicants and posters share contact details only after the company accepts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_pilot_car_escorts · Private data: search_open_loads, search_open_jobs · Public sink: search_open_jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_pilot_car_escorts · Private data: search_open_loads, search_open_jobs · Public sink: search_open_jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
